title: These grumpy cats aren't in a festive mood!
description:
Credit: SWNS / Elaine Wynne

A cat mum dressed her sassy cats in Christmas outfits – but amusing videos show they are NOT amused.

Elaine Wynne, 60, bought Christmas outfits for her three sphynxes, and their Grinch-like reactions to her festivities are hilarious.

The self-confessed ‘crazy cat lady’ from Bullwell, Nottingham, recorded the moment her furry friends Pumpernickel, Sizzle and Mr Magoo reacted to their outfits.

Pumpernickel, three, sports a red coat and festive hat, while Sizzle, one, is wearing a coat with ‘The Grinch’ on, and Mr Magoo, five, is dressed as Santa Claus himself.

Pumpernickel gave Elaine looks of pure hatred while the others remained hilariously indifferent.

She said the outfits keep them cosy in winter due to their lack of fur.
